messages:
marie: Quick help — MediHealth POC (Android) demo failing. SSE stream throws `JSON.parse Unexpected end of input` after ~12-18s. Can eng advise? cc @sara

sara: Is there an API gateway/CDN in front? Can you paste the client error + raw SSE fragments?

marie: They go through Apigee. Android log:
```
E/Stream: JSON.parse: Unexpected end of input
last_chunk='{\"note\":\"Follow-up on med'
```
Raw concat from client:
```
data: {"type":"note","payload":{"id":9,"note":"Follow-up on med


data: ication sent"}}

```

devon: Looks like the JSON is split across chunk/event boundary. Most likely gateway buffering or idle timeout causes coalescing/splitting. Short fixes: disable response buffering/enable streaming on Apigee, set `Content-Type: text/event-stream`, `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`, and add `X-Accel-Buffering: no` if using nginx in front. Also disable gzip for this route.

devon: From server side, flush after each event and emit a comment heartbeat every ~8s: `: keepalive\n\n` so gateway idle timeouts don't close the connection. Heartbeat must be shorter than their idle timeout.

sara: On client side, ensure SSE parser aggregates lines until the event terminator (double newline) before calling `JSON.parse`. As fallback, NDJSON could be used but requires client change.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: POC-2345 escalated to eng-oncall (tag: sse-streaming)

marie: I'll join their call in 15m to walk them through toggling streaming and push a quick heartbeat patch to our demo tenant. Will report back here. :thumbsup:
